programme.desc: Cerita sinetron ini mengangkat pertemanan di dunia game online. Awalnya hanya sekadar main bareng, lama-lama menjadi jatuh cinta beneran. Cinta Sedalam Rindu?menceritakan Aluna (Esta Pramanita) yang menyembunyikan identitasnya di?game online?sebagai Gulagula. Tak disangka, ia dekat dengan Ezra (Farhan Rasyid) yang memakai nama Ezy. Ezra jatuh cinta dan ingin bertemu, tapi Aluna terus menghindar karena malu. Untuk mengetahui keseruan ceritanya saksikan tayangannya setiap hari, hanya di SCTV.

programme.title: Jejak Duka Diandra
programme.desc: Kisah cinta Diandra (Michelle Ziudith) dan Dimitri (Rio Dewanto) yang semula indah, seketika berubah drastis setelah Yunita (Baiti Syaghaf), saudara tiri Diandra mengaku mencintai Dimitri. Dimitri terjebak dalam situasi sulit akibat ulah sang adik, Jupiter (Bizael) yang menuduh Dimitri melecehkan Yunita. Hubungan Dimitri dengan Diandra pun semakin merenggang. Tuduhan lainnya juga harus diterima Dimitri sebagai penyebab insiden kecelakaan seorang wanita. Posisi Dimitri semakin terpojok setelah Diandra yang diminta sebagai saksi justru tidak berpihak kepadanya hingga Dimitri mendapat sanksi mendekam di balik jeruji besi selama lima tahun.Lima tahun berlalu, Dimitri hidup bebas dan melanjutkan usaha sang ayah. Ia pun membuka kisah cinta baru dengan Melissa (Tasya Panggabean). Takdir pun berkata lain, pertemuan Dimitri dan Diandra kembali terjadi...kisah selengkapnya, silakan saksikan hanya di SCTV.

Ia pun menjadi Shinigami pengganti, bertugas melindungi manusia dari Hollow sekaligus mengantarkan arwah ke alam baka, sambil menjalani kehidupan sekolahnya. Petualangan Naruto melibatkan pelatihan intensif, pertempuran sengit melawan musuh kuat seperti Pain, dan upaya untuk mencegah sahabatnya, Sasuke, jatuh lebih dalam ke kegelapan.

programme.desc: Dalimi Yang Penyayang Selalu Peduli Dengan Semua Orang Di Sekitarnya, Mulai Dari Ayahnya, Ibunya, Teman-Temannya, Kakeknya, Adiknya, Dan Anjing Peliharaan Keluarga Milky. Setiap Episodenya, Kita Akan Mengikuti Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Dalimi Bersama Orang Tersayang.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Beyblade X
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Kisah Robin Kazami, Seorang Blader Muda Yang Ditinggalkan Timnya Setelah Kekalahan Telak. Dia Kemudian Bertemu Dengan Jaxon Cross, Mantan Juara Beyblade, Dan Mereka Berdua Membentuk Tim Baru Bernama Tim Persona. Bersama Dengan Anggota Ketiga Tim, Multi Nana-Iro, Mereka Bercita-Cita Untuk Mencapai Puncak Liga Beyblade X.

programme.title: Ultraman Orb
programme.desc: Drama Tokusatsu Jepang Yang Menceritakan Kisah Naomi Yumeno Yang Memiliki Mimpi Aneh Tentang Cahaya Raksasa Yang Bersinar Melawan Monster Raksasa. Naomi Yumeno, Jetta Hayami, Dan Shin Matsudo Kemudian Menemukan Binatang Misterius Tak Dikenal Yang Diduga Menyebabkan Aktivitas Meteorologi Yang Aneh. Mereka Menuju Pusat Cuaca Aneh Dan Bertemu Dengan Monster Angin, Maga-Basser! Naomi Dihempas Oleh Angin Ganas Tetapi Diselamatkan Oleh Gelandangan, Gai Kurenai. programme.title: Metal Cardbot

Setiap episode menyoroti hasil dan analisis pertandingan, profil atlet, serta isu-isu menarik seputar manajemen klub dan federasi olahraga, mencakup berbagai cabang olahraga. Dengan penyampaian yang dinamis dan informatif, SPORT ZONE bertujuan mendekatkan pemirsa dengan euforia olahraga dan membekali mereka dengan pengetahuan akurat, menjadikannya pilihan tepat untuk tetap terhubung dengan berita dan cerita menarik dari arena olahraga.

programme.title: Bincang Spesial
programme.desc: Bincang Spesial di Sin Po TV adalah program wawancara mendalam yang menghadirkan tokoh-tokoh penting dan berpengaruh. Acara ini menggali pemikiran, visi, dan perjalanan hidup narasumber, dari pemimpin negara hingga seniman, yang memiliki dampak signifikan. Melalui percakapan yang tajam, program ini berupaya membongkar sisi lain narasumber, termasuk tantangan dan prinsip hidup mereka. Dengan penyampaian intim dan personal, Bincang Spesial bertujuan memberikan wawasan eksklusif, menginspirasi, dan mendorong pemahaman tentang kepemimpinan serta kontribusi dalam masyarakat. Program ini cocok bagi siapa saja yang ingin mengenal lebih dekat tokoh-tokoh berpengaruh di Indonesia.

programme.title: Menyapa Indonesia Petang
programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Petang di Sin Po TV adalah program berita utama sore hari yang merangkum seluruh peristiwa penting sepanjang hari. Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif tentang dinamika politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan budaya di Indonesia dan dunia. Setiap episode menyajikan berita terkini, laporan mendalam, dan analisis dari ahli, serta update isu hangat, cuaca, dan segmen inspiratif. Dengan penyampaian yang padat informasi dan mudah dicerna, program ini membekali pemirsa dengan pemahaman menyeluruh tentang perkembangan terkini di penghujung hari.

programme.title: Islam Penuh Cinta
programme.desc: Islam Penuh Cinta di Sin Po TV adalah program tausiyah agama islam, yang menampilkan Islam sebagai agama rahmat bagi semesta alam. Memberikan pemahaman konsep cinta dari sudut pandang Islam yang terdapat dalam Al-quran dan Hadist. Selain memeberikan ilmu ke islaman, Islam penuh cinta juga mengajak pemirsa memahami nilai-nilai persatuan, persaudaraan, keadilan, dan kepedulian serta menumbuhkan cinta serta damai di hati setiap orang.

programme.title: Kilas Sepekan
programme.desc: KILAS SEPEKAN adalah program berita mingguan Sin Po TV yang merangkum deretan peristiwa penting dalam sepekan terakhir-dari dinamika politik, ekonomi, sosial, hingga kabar internasional. Dipandu oleh Arif Rifai, program ini disajikan secara padat, tajam, dan informatif, Newswrap menjadi referensi untuk pemirsa yang ingin tetap update tanpa harus melewatkan waktu.

programme.title: Ruang Kabinet
programme.desc: RUANG KABINET di Sin Po TV adalah program khusus yang menyajikan liputan eksklusif dan mendalam tentang kegiatan dan agenda resmi para menteri Kabinet Indonesia Maju. Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif mengenai kinerja dan kebijakan pemerintah. Setiap episode menyoroti pertemuan antar-kementerian, kunjungan kerja, peresmian program, hingga rapat kabinet, menggali makna, tujuan, dan implikasi setiap aktivitas terhadap pembangunan negara dan masyarakat. Dengan akses langsung dan liputan detail, CABINET ACTIVITY bertujuan mendekatkan pemirsa dengan kinerja pemerintahan dan meningkatkan pemahaman publik mengenai peran setiap kementerian dalam menjalankan program strategis nasional, relevan bagi siapa pun yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan kebijakan pemerintah.

Dengan penyampaian yang dinamis dan informatif, SPORT ZONE bertujuan mendekatkan pemirsa dengan euforia olahraga dan membekali mereka dengan pengetahuan akurat, menjadikannya pilihan tepat untuk tetap terhubung dengan berita dan cerita menarik dari arena olahraga.

programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Morphle 2D - English

programme.title: Titipo Titipo
programme.desc: Kereta api kecil yang baru lahir dari Train Center TITIPO baru saja lulus ujian mengemudi dan siap untuk bekerja di Desa Kereta. Meskipun TITIPO bercita-cita menjadi kereta terbaik di dunia, kepribadiannya yang penasaran namun acak menangkapnya dalam peristiwa dan masalah yang tidak terduga setiap hari.

programme.title: Petok Si Ayam Kampung
programme.desc: Serial Stop Motion tentang seekor ayam jantan ,bernama "Petok" yang beranjak dewasa, dan merasa dirinya tidak se-spesial hewan-hewan piaraan majikannya. Oleh karena itu Ia selalu berusaha menunjukkan kepada majikannya bahawa Ia adalah ayam yang serba bisa.

programme.title: Samufly
programme.desc: Bos Jahat mengotori sungai dan mengirimkan bom sampah untuk menghancurkan kota, para Samufly dan Master Mantis bertarung dengan Bos Jahat untuk melindungi kota dan menghentikannya.

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, Landau'S Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Seorang anak laki-laki menggunakan teknologi alien yang mengubahnya menjadi pahlawan super, saat ia bertempur melawan alien yang kecanduan biji kakao.

programme.title: Pororo
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo Thematic Show

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: Australian universities are in turmoil. Deep cuts to jobs and courses are triggering fury on campuses. Years of shrinking public funding, rising debt and increasingly corporate decision-making pushed some to breaking point.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Greece is one of the world's most popular tourist destinations, but the actual population of Greece is in freefall. There are far more deaths than births, young people have left in droves and migration is deeply unpopular.

programme.title: ABC News Overnight
programme.desc: The final word on the day's top stories, with the latest news and updated information from Australia's most trusted source of independent news. Presented by Mariam Saab.

programme.title: The World This Week
programme.desc: Girish Sawlani brings you a weekly roundup of international news from an Australian perspective as reported by ABC News correspondents covering the Indo Pacific, Europe, North America, the Middle East, India and Indonesia.

programme.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
programme.desc: In this heat, nine artists have four hours to create a portrait of a celebrity sitter: Paralympian Madison de Rozario OAM, TV and radio host Amanda Keller, and actor/comedian Matt Okine.

programme.title: Indonesia Down Under
programme.desc: Travel across Australia and discover the culture, food and special historical ties that Indonesia and Australia share. Delve into the connections as we highlight the rich Indonesian influences found in Australian communities.

programme.title: The Pool
programme.desc: Bondi Icebergs is the most photographed pool in the world. For nearly a century this spectacular 50 metre stretch of sparkling blue at the southern end of Bondi Beach has occupied a special corner in the hearts of millions.

programme.desc: Born in Tunisia, Nadia Ounais has been passionate about diving and oceanography since childhood. After a brilliant career in biology and oceanology, she takes over the direction of the Oceanographic Institute of Monaco. Deeply attached to her native country, she participated in the renovation of the Salammbo aquarium.

programme.title: Riverboom
programme.desc: Afghanistan, 2002. Three young reporters decide to leave Kabul and head to the interior of the country, where Westerners are much rarer. They set off by car and film their impromptu journey.

programme.title: 47 Pouces
programme.desc: One night, seven-year-old Zelie sees her Aunt Clara arrive at the family home. The young woman is sad, has bandages on her wrists and does not leave her room.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rtbf

programme.title: Enquetes De Region
programme.desc: At the crossroads of Switzerland and Italy, the Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes region is the second in France in terms of migratory flows. The situation is mixed and affects large cities more than rural departments, but it has led the region to explore the issue of ''living together''.

programme.title: Le Journal Afrique
programme.desc: All the African news from the TV5MONDE news staff.

programme.title: Version Francaise
programme.desc: We head off to the Fine Arts Museum in Libourne. Deep dive into sculptor Hugo Servanin's library of bodies and engineering laboratory. Danish designer Cecilie Bahnsen: combining Scandinavian pragmatism with French know-how. Discovery: digital light embroidery by Lou de Pray.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rts
programme.desc: All the news from RTS.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (8 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: 64' Actu
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's major daily news programme, decrypting the news! What you need to know: the Francophone view of the day's main events. Economics, social debates, international news: the expertise of our journalists. New weekend features: the French-speaking world, social networks, fake news, politics, sport...

programme.title: 64' Debat
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's major daily news programme, decrypting the news! What it's all about: the guests take an in-depth look at a key issue. Increased focus on Francophone cultural news, with dedicated sequences. New weekend features: the French-speaking world, social networks, fake news, politics, sport...

programme.title: Terriennes
programme.desc: The ''Terriennes'' portal: a site in French on the status of women around the world.

programme.title: L'Invite
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin hosts the stars in the headlines, culture, music, film, books, an unmissable rendezvous with all those who light up our times.

programme.title: Yetili
programme.desc: Nina and Leon, two little mice, live in a bookshop whose mascot is a large yeti cuddly toy called Yetili. Each evening, once the bookshop has closed, Yetili comes to life and settles his two friends on his knees to read them a story.

programme.title: Yetili
programme.desc: Nina and Leon, two little mice, live in a bookshop whose mascot is a large yeti cuddly toy called Yetili. Each evening, once the bookshop has closed, Yetili comes to life and settles his two friends on his knees to read them a story.

programme.title: Dounia
programme.desc: Dounia and her grandparents are gradually getting to know Canada, their new country. But for little Dounia, it isn't easy to get used to its seasons, food and language. She misses her father terribly. Fortunately her new friends rally round to help her make progress.

programme.title: Les Metiers
programme.desc: To gain a better understanding of some professions, school children explain jobs to their parents in their own words.

programme.title: Ta Vie Sans Ca
programme.desc: What would life be like without our most everyday objects? Each episode puts a different one in the spotlight. Whether a tap, an umbrella or a toothbrush, they all have a story to tell about their invention and subsequent evolution.

programme.title: La Clef - C'Est Quoi Ton Truc Julie ?
programme.desc: Julie Provencher is a mother passionate about education. With her, it's impossible to get bored! In each episode, she gives tips and tricks to parents so they can educate their children while having fun.

programme.title: Partie De Campagne
programme.desc: Surrounded by fields, near a vast forest and a pretty stream, lies the village of Bellefontaine. It's home to the fun-loving gang of friends Raphael, Lina, P'tit Pied and Grande Perche. Bubbling over with imagination, they fill every day with exciting adventures.

programme.title: Partie De Campagne
programme.desc: Surrounded by fields, near a vast forest and a pretty stream, lies the village of Bellefontaine. It's home to the fun-loving gang of friends Raphael, Lina, P'tit Pied and Grande Perche. Bubbling over with imagination, they fill every day with exciting adventures.

programme.title: Les Triples
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: Potobot
programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: L'Aventure Du Monde Des Mondes
programme.desc: Dimitri, Raph's and Anais's uncle, is a French globetrotter who is fascinated by nature. He gives them tasks to stimulate their creativity. Thanks to Blox, a small robot, they access the ''world of the worlds'', a secret fantasy place where they can play and learn.

programme.title: Roi Keita
programme.desc: The entire empire is on alert: Soundiata Keita's mother has been kidnapped. Abdul, as thirsty for power as ever, heads to the city of the sacred baobab trees.

programme.title: Basik

programme.title: Ep08: Martin Keown : PL Moments
programme.desc: With over 300 appearances for Arsenal, Martin Keown is an iconic figure at the North London club. A member of the Invincibles, Keown was a graduate of the Arsenal academy before moving to Aston Villa and then Everton before returning to Highbury. A three-time Premier League champion, Keown sits down with PL Moments to talk us through his remarkable journey and select his top ten moments from throughout his time in the Premier League.?

programme.title: Ep43: (Subbed) Willian : PL Stories
programme.desc: We join Willian in Gremio, Brazil, where he is currently continuing his playing career, as he reflects on an incredible journey in the Premier League. Sharing insights from his time at Chelsea and that controversial move across London to Arsenal and then Fulham, Willian opens up about the highs, challenges and defining moments that shaped his career at the top level of English football. From playing in World Cup's with Brazil to Premier League title wins with Chelsea, this is a story of determination, grit and a lifelong love of the game.

programme.title: Ep44: Yakubu : PL Stories
programme.desc: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, PL Stories spends time with Yakubu Aiyegbeni at Finchley Boxing Club, where he is forging a new path in the next chapter of his sporting life. We explore his growing passion for boxing and the discipline it demands, offering a fresh perspective on life after football. Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers. From his impact on the pitch to his evolving identity beyond the game, this is an intimate portrait of a player embracing life after football.

programme.title: Ep33: Danny Welbeck : The Big Interview
programme.desc: With 87 goals to his name Danny Welbeck is the fifth-highest goalscorer among active Premier League players, and across a career spanning 17 seasons he has seen it all. This week, the Brighton striker sits down with former teammate Owen Hargreaves to reflect on his remarkable journey. From his early days at Manchester United and being crowned champion in 2013, to his move to Arsenal where he overcame adversity, and now to his current role thriving as a leader for the Seagulls. Having already matched last season's career high goal tally this term, the 35-year-old has found a new lease of life on the South Coast and discusses how he is passing on his knowledge and experience to the next generation.

programme.title: Ep34: Rodrigo Gomes : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Ruben Neves, Joao Moutinho, Jose Sa. Wolverhampton Wanderers have a long history of Portuguese players shining in the Old Gold at Molineux. Another player looking to add his name to that list is Rodrigo Gomes. This week, Gomes is joined by Shaun Wright-Phillips to discuss his journey from the Braga academy to joining Wolves in 2024. The pair also take an in-depth look at his play this season, and head to the training pitch to recreate some iconic Wolves goals.

programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Xhaka also looks back on his time at Arsenal, losing the armband and the lessons he learned at the Emirates, as well as his spell with Bayer Leverkusen and their historic unbeaten season en route to the Bundesliga title in 2024.
